heading_path: Part 17A—Protected international trade marks under the Madrid Protocol
Division 10—Recording of claimed interests and rights
17A.63  Notification of matters affecting trade mark
text: The Registrar must notify each person who has a claim recorded in respect of a trade mark of any matter affecting the trade mark that is notified to the Registrar by the International Bureau.
